title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README and PROJECT_MAP, which describe the Zalo assistant bot: installation, first run, the ZaloBot app and the web/VPS features. PROJECT_MAP gives an architecture matrix and a task-to-file lookup, a roadmap for the rest of this tour.

title: Entry Points and CLI
description: python -m bot starts src/bot/__main__.py, which delegates to command_line.py, the argparse CLI with subcommands such as run, gui, console, login, update and admin. It has high fan-out, wiring together most subsystems. Note that pyproject.toml declares a console script 'zalo-bot = bot.cli:main', but src/bot/cli.py does not exist, so that entry is stale; the working paths are python -m bot and the packaging entry zalobot_entry.py.

title: Settings and Userdata Paths
description: config.py (fan-in 17) loads Settings from environment variables and settings.env, and userdata_paths.py defines the APP_HOME and userdata folder layout. Nearly every later module depends on these two, so they are the shared foundation. The env.example template lists the available options.

title: Shared Helpers and Storage
description: Small helpers like vietnam_time (fixed UTC+7) and text_fold (accent-free matching) are widely imported leaf modules. The storage package builds on text_files' atomic writes to provide per-chat data stores, and process_lock prevents two bot processes from sharing one data directory.

title: Receiving Zalo Messages
description: The zalo package normalizes incoming payloads into IncomingMessage and talks to the Zalo Bot Platform through an httpx client. Messages arrive by long polling or the FastAPI webhook receiver, while personal_account and qr_login support running on a personal account. These modules feed the handler in the next step.

title: Message Handling Core
description: message_handler.py is the Bot orchestrator: it receives payloads and applies filtering, roles, rate limiting and owner commands before invoking the agent. It builds on message_filter, roles and owner_commands, and on the storage and helpers from earlier steps.

title: Gemini Agent and Tools
description: GeminiAgent runs a bounded function-calling loop with retries, using a system prompt built from SYSTEM.md and MEMORY.md. The tool registry auto-discovers tool modules such as assign_events and schedule_web, so new abilities can be added by dropping in a file.
languageLesson: Function calling lets the model request a named tool with structured arguments; the host runs it and feeds the result back. Capping the number of rounds keeps the loop bounded.

title: System Services and Remote Control
description: The system package manages background processes, first-run setup, auto-update, and the local-to-VPS link through remote_server, remote_config and handover. bot_process uses lock and PID files, and handover moves the bot's data between a local machine and a VPS. docs/vps-dieu-khien.md explains this control flow.

title: Admin Web Server and UI
description: admin_web_server.py is a FastAPI server bound to localhost with authenticated /api routes, backed by admin_sessions and settings_file, which edits the .env file atomically. The static single-page admin UI (index.html, admin_page.js, theme CSS) talks to these routes.

title: Desktop App
description: desktop_app.py shows the admin UI in a WebView2 window with a system tray icon from pystray. Icons are drawn with Pillow, and windows_autostart registers launch at Windows login, so the whole bot becomes a desktop app.

title: Packaging and Deployment
description: build-exe.ps1 and ZaloBot.spec build the one-file ZaloBot.exe with PyInstaller, and check_secrets.py scans the output for forbidden files. ZaloBot.cmd bootstraps a venv for source installs, while run-forever.ps1 and install-task.ps1 keep the bot running via Task Scheduler.
languageLesson: A PyInstaller .spec file is Python code describing the entry script, bundled data and output mode, so the build is repeatable.

title: Tests and Further Docs
description: conftest.py supplies fakes (FakeZalo, FakeAgent, FakeWeb) used across the suite, and test_bot.py exercises the handler end to end. docs/lenh-zalo.md documents the chat commands for each role and PLAN.md records design decisions.
